authorization: 追加一轮 RGB 离线研究
method: OpenCV pyramidal Lucas-Kanade, forward/backward check; fixed surviving features; relative horizontal finger displacement. One zero-intercept image-motion slope per feedback/command baseline, trained only on residual grasp.
limits: These are finger surface features, not inner aperture landmarks
No metric scale or absolute aperture identified
Temporal interpolation uses existing archived HDF5 clock; exposure timing not independently calibrated
No physics promotion solely from a pixel/motor regression
ROIs chosen after visual inspection of three representative frames per episode; heldout motion traces and residuals not used for fitting or threshold tuning
